notes.title: New content update
notes.content:
1. Food selection has been implemented (character performance changes)


Now, players can delegate meals, which, once consumed, can enhance their growth path within the game.

There are also hidden menus that need to be unlocked by defeating enemies or progressing through the storyline.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/7a9b4cf1609dc113232578fb2c26c391f63797a8.png"]


2. Bug fixes
- Fixed the issue of game crash when returning to the base in the wave reward interface

- Fixed the issue where character training rewards were not effective

- Fixed the issue where character names could not be entered in new games


3. Optimization
-Adjusted the values of some artifacts

-Adjusted the health recovery value for wave rewards

notes.title: [Major Update] Additional character growth and new route choices
notes.content:
Preparing for the official release, I optimized a ton of content!
New character illustrations
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/de5ea29e39e5d15081e19b0721bbc26140a3cbe4.png"]
New system:
After completing a mission, your level can be converted into experience points

Experience points can be used to enhance your character's attributes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45329384/455965f8bfc81aa2cd49648d6d558caf14a7402b.png"]

Weapon selection, synthesis, and weapon chest rewards,

Multiple artifact selections and upgrades

Artifact upgrades provide even more powerful effects!
New route selection:
You can now challenge the Slime King!

Defeat each wave of enemies until you face the Slime King.
other:
Optimized enemy targeting

Optimized player character controls

notes.title: EA Ver0.3 update
notes.content:
-> New content, adding more skills.
Echo of Life: Triggers an shockwave after HP changes 10 times, damage affected by defense.
Supply Crate: At the start of battle, periodically generates a crate near the player.
Energy Shield: Creates a protective shield that blocks multiple attacks before entering cooldown.
Frugal: Gain coins after defeating enemies.
Aftermath: Receive healing when losing coins, with a 3s cooldown.
Cicada Sheds Its Shell: Extends invincibility time after taking damage.
Finger Snap: Periodically deals 0 damage to self.

-> Adjusted the aggression of the Stone Golem boss.

-> Optimized the excessive attack hitboxes of Slime minions.

-> Added an achievement system.

*Still unsure how to handle the extra-progression system.

I will continue to update the content.

notes.title: effect pick panel update
notes.content: Fixed the issue of the joystick's cross key not being able to focus on the button.

notes.title: 2025.03.11 Update
notes.content:
Optimized the combat supply in the process, and the medicine can also be found in boxes in subsequent levels, but the quantity is not as large as before.

Optimized the operation of the handle, there will be a slight automatic aiming when using the handle.

There may be compatibility bugs when using godot4.4, to be verified.
